events.title: TechLabs Düsseldorf Meetup
events.blurb: Join our local community for networking, project showcases, and tech talks.
description: Connect with fellow learners, alumni, and mentors in a relaxed evening format. We spotlight community projects, share lessons learned, and make space for open networking.
Whether you are deep in a track or just curious about TechLabs, you are welcome. Bring questions, a short demo if you have one, and your enthusiasm for tech.

events.title: Web Development Workshop
events.blurb: Hands-on session on modern web development with React and TypeScript.
description: A practical workshop focused on building accessible, type-safe interfaces with React and TypeScript. We work through a small feature slice from design to implementation.
Bring your laptop. You will pair briefly, ship a working component, and leave with patterns you can reuse in your own projects.

events.title: Data Science Career Panel
events.blurb: Learn from industry experts about breaking into data science and AI.
description: Hear how practitioners moved from learning to their first data roles. Panelists cover hiring expectations, portfolio work, and how to stand out ethically in AI-driven teams.
There will be plenty of time for audience questions. Come prepared with your career questions.

events.title: Product Design Portfolio Review
events.blurb: Get feedback on your portfolio from experienced designers and mentors.
description: Bring your portfolio (PDF, site, or deck) for structured feedback in small mentor groups. We focus on narrative, impact, and how hiring managers scan work.
Slots are limited so everyone gets meaningful attention. You will leave with concrete next steps.

events.title: AI Ethics Workshop
events.blurb: Explore the ethical implications of AI and machine learning in modern applications.
description: A facilitated workshop on fairness, transparency, and accountability when shipping ML features. We use short case studies and group discussion—no PhD required.
You will practice framing risks, communicating limitations to stakeholders, and building review habits that scale with your team.

events.title: Graduation Ceremony 2024
events.blurb: Celebrating the achievements of our latest cohort of TechLabs graduates.
description: We celebrated our graduates with families, mentors, and partners. The afternoon included project demos, awards, and plenty of photos.
Thank you to everyone who supported the cohort—this community is what makes TechLabs special.

events.title: Hackathon: Sustainable Tech
events.blurb: 24-hour hackathon focused on building solutions for environmental challenges.
description: Teams prototyped sustainable tech ideas—from energy dashboards to circular-economy apps—in one intense weekend.
Partners provided datasets and domain mentors; participants left with demos and new friendships across tracks.

events.title: Mentor Networking Event
events.blurb: Connect with TechLabs mentors and learn about mentorship opportunities.
description: An evening designed for mentors and learners to meet in a low-pressure setting. Short intros, topic tables, and open conversation.
Many mentorship matches started from nights like this one.

events.title: Tech Career Fair
events.blurb: Meet potential employers and explore career opportunities in tech.
description: Employers and startups met candidates in speed-networking and booth formats. Resume reviews and interview tips were available all day.
Participants reported stronger clarity on roles and next skills to build.

events.title: Summer Coding Bootcamp
events.blurb: Intensive 2-week program covering web development fundamentals.
description: A structured two-week sprint through HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React basics—with daily labs and project checkpoints.
Graduates left with a deployed portfolio project and a clear path into the TechLabs tracks.
